text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Masters was fast approaching. A 
race to stand alongside the Three 
Goddesses and aim even higher. A race to 
reach the very pinnacle of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beyond their immense knowledge, the Three 
Goddesses taught what truly matters when 
running alongside an Umamusume as a 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then they wanted the Three Goddesses who 
supported them to witness how much they 
had grown. To that end, the Goddess 
possessing the knowledge they needed most 
was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inheriting Darley Arabian's spirit and 
believing in her own strengths, <chrname> will run 
all the way through the Grand Masters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Acquired <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely prove that I took their 
feelings to heart!
